race.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 1)
race.verdict: A well-run race looks in store and RIDGER can strike after a narrow defeat last time. Fellow 3-y-o Dark Mandate has made a positive start with this yard and should be thereabouts, while Montpellier Green can't be ignored from a dangerous mark. RIDGER (IRE) DARK MANDATE MONTPELLIER GREEN (IRE)
